title: Forgel Code 0.1.0
request: Publish Forgel Code 0.1.0: declare the test dependencies in pyproject.toml and ship the client release.

audit.summary: The change set implements the test extra and metadata emission, and the test suite passes, but the README test-extra install URL points at v0.1.1 instead of the 0.1.0 release tag, so the documented install path is broken; minor documentation and lint issues remain.

findings.issue: README's new test-extra install command points at `.../refs/tags/v0.1.1.tar.gz[test]`, while the release record, changelog and release id are 0.1.0 (`v0.1.0`). Users following the release docs will fetch a wrong or nonexistent tag, breaking the documented test-extra install path.
findings.suggestion: Change the URL to `v0.1.0` (or the actual published tag) and add a README-test assertion that the tag matches the package/release version so it cannot drift.

findings.issue: README's new sentence says the checkout suite 'needs nothing but the Python standard library', but `tests/test_extras.py`'s `OfflineExtraInstallTest` calls `_pip_python()` and fails if no Python 3.9+ with pip is available, so the documented no-install command can fail on a stdlib-only interpreter.
findings.suggestion: Reword the claim to say no package installation is required, or make the pip test skip when pip is unavailable while keeping the offline install test in environments with pip.

findings.issue: `_build_backend.py` adds `import re` but never uses it; this can fail the project's `make lint` check.
findings.suggestion: Remove the unused import or use it.

detail: The change set implements the test extra and metadata emission, and the test suite passes, but the README test-extra install URL points at v0.1.1 instead of the 0.1.0 release tag, so the documented install path is broken; minor documentation and lint issues remain.
